svg.title: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction B: Isometric diorama
svg.text: Trickbound · Town and station v2 (#21) · Direction B: Isometric diorama
Cinder Hollow, Leg 1. Concept sheet, code-drawn SVG (no image model). Hex codes only from art/art-direction.md (draft).
The town at phone size (1x, 384 × 480 view)
The station interior at phone size (1x, 384 × 320 view)
2x detail: a card table under the lamp
States: Arrival (one lamp of two working) → Lamp-lit (the town’s first critter wakes)
In the game: phone frame (390 wide) with the UI and the hand on top
Tap a label or a person
Idea: three-quarter isometric dioramas (what the v3 scope already calls “isometric depot rooms”): real walls, depth and lamplight pooling on the floor.
Risk: the walk code is a square top-down grid, so iso needs new movement and draw order, and tall walls can hide the player.
